name: BlackHole Engine SDK

compatibilityPolicy.whenNoSdkSpecified: Use the manifest default SDK reference. This points to the latest bundled SDK snapshot.
compatibilityPolicy.whenOlderSdkSpecified: Use the latest bundled SDK reference because API documentation is maintained as latest-only.
compatibilityPolicy.whenSdkErrorOrUpgradeIssue: Search upgrade-notes.md for version-specific changes, bug fixes, breaking behavior, and migration guidance.
compatibilityPolicy.compatibilityNote: Project guidance indicates BlackHole Engine APIs are backward-compatible across SDK updates. Keep one latest API reference and one curated upgrade note file for SDK-specific issues.

upgradeNotes.purpose: Official SDK upgrade, compatibility, bug-fix, and migration notes to check when a user reports SDK errors or upgrade problems.

notes: Maintain only the latest API Markdown reference in references.
Preserve the official API manual filename style: BlackHole Engine API_Web-v<version>.md.
When adding a newer SDK snapshot, replace the prior API reference entry and update defaultSdkVersion.
Preserve SDK-specific upgrade, bug-fix, and compatibility notes in upgrade-notes.md instead of keeping full historical API docs.
Refresh upgrade-notes.md from the official source API when recent/latest SDK updates matter.
